title: CrisisBench: an evaluation suite for crisis counseling AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.21622v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Crisis helplines are essential to mental health systems but are often understaffed and underfunded. LLMs could support counselors, but existing benchmarks do not capture the escalation, risk assessment, and de-escalation central to crisis conversations, while privacy restrictions limit use of real transcripts. Methods: We present CrisisBench, a privacy-preserving suite for single- and multi-turn crisis counseling evaluation. It includes 1,085 single-turn tasks from 200 de-identified conversations and 1,185 patient LLMs derived from hotline metadata. Patient models and a 23-item LLM judge were calibrated against expert counselors. Results: We evaluated five GPT models plus draft-then-edit and retrieval-augmented generation. All systems underperformed human counselors on excessive empathy and questioning in single-turn evaluation. translated_title: CrisisBench：危机心理辅导AI的评估套件
translated_abstract: 背景：危机热线对心理健康系统至关重要，但常常面临人员不足和资金短缺的问题。大型语言模型（LLM）可以为辅导员提供支持，但现有的基准测试无法捕捉危机对话中至关重要的情绪升级、风险评估和去升级（安抚降级）过程，同时隐私限制也限制了真实对话记录的使用。方法：我们提出了CrisisBench，这是一个用于单轮和多轮危机辅导评估的隐私保护型评估套件。它包含来自200个去标识化对话的1,085个单轮任务，以及基于热线元数据衍生的1,185个患者LLM模拟模型。患者模型和一个包含23个评分项目的LLM评判器均经过专家辅导员的校准。结果：我们评估了五个GPT模型以及“先起草后编辑”和检索增强生成（RAG）方法。在单轮评估中，所有系统在过度共情和提问方面均不及人类辅导员。该评分标准在人与人之间的Krippendorff's α系数为0.51，LLM与人之间的α系数为0.54（Pear...
tldr: CrisisBench是一个隐私保护的危机心理辅导AI评估套件，通过去标识化的真实热线对话、模拟患者的LLM以及经专家校准的评判标准来评估模型表现，结果显示现有LLM系统在危机对话中仍不及人类辅导员。
en_tdlr: CrisisBench is a privacy-preserving evaluation suite for crisis counseling AI, built from de-identified hotline conversations with simulated patient LLMs and expert-calibrated judging, revealing that current LLM systems still underperform human counselors in crisis conversations.
